preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or become owner through social engineering/compromise)
Contract must have accumulated BNB balance from taxes (swap fees) or initial deployment

exploit_hint: As owner, call sweepContingency() before liquidity is added to drain all BNB from contract to owner address. Alternatively, after liquidity is added, use setWallets() to change tax recipient wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, then trigger contractSwap() via normal trading to divert tax BNB to attacker. Can also use multiSendTokens() to transfer large amounts of tokens to attacker-controlled accounts without fees.
